_meta.purpose: The locked debate material. The engine picks matchups/tiers/takes ONLY from this file (guardrail G1). It never invents Austin references at runtime.
_meta.provenance: Merged from Perplexity status-check pass + Manus evergreen bank (research dated ~Aug 2026). Where the two disagreed, Perplexity's open/closed verdict wins.

tagging.status: confirmed_open = a recent source lists current operation | closed = verified closed, DO NOT POST | unconfirmed = likely open but not verified to standard, VERIFY before posting
tagging.recurrence: evidenced = Perplexity found real recent threads of people arguing it | plausible_unverified = Manus-listed, culturally plausible but NOT confirmed as a recurring fight. Quarantined: usable, but deprioritize until a comment section proves it's live.
tagging.used: set true after posting so it isn't repeated

engine_rules_reminder: NEVER post status:unconfirmed without verifying open TODAY.
PREFER recurrence:evidenced + status:confirmed_open for early rounds (strongest, safest).
plausible_unverified is fine to use, but treat early results as a test of whether that fight is real; harvest what lands.
Provocation on TASTE only, never on facts, closures, or attribution (G4).
critical_corrections_from_research: Valentina's Tex Mex BBQ is CLOSED. Removed from all matchups.
Vaquero Taquero: OPEN at North Campus (104 E 31st); old downtown Sabine location closed -> became Taco N Maiz.
P. Terry's: OPEN and expanded 24hr; the Capital Plaza / I-35 flagship closed. Nostalgia must say 'Cap Plaza P. Terry's', never 'P. Terry's is gone'.
Amy's, Lick, Home Slice, Via 313: status unconfirmed - verify before posting.
